title: 第1章 仙宫机缘金丹大战得宝逃遁第2章 顾景元神秘兽鼎
content_zh:
玄沧东域，金元宗。
金元宗最东北方向的金玉坊市，朝南数十里外。
天际尽头，一座仙宫的琉璃玉瓦刺破云海和空间裂缝，宫墙流淌着淡金霞光，散发出亘古苍茫的气息。
突然间，仙宫之外，金光一闪，三道身影凭空出现。
一位身穿金色云纹道袍，面容俊朗，看上去约三十许人，剑眉斜飞入鬓，鼻梁高挺，紧抿的薄唇为其增添了几分肃杀之气。
他身姿挺拔如松，静立时仿佛一柄收入鞘中的神兵，自有一股凛然不可侵犯的威严。
另一位，面容粗犷，下颌方阔，身高近九尺，浑身肌肉虬结如老树盘根，充满了爆炸性的力量。他的肌肤呈现出一种健康的古铜色，并且布满了纵横交错的伤疤。
两人都是金丹初期的修为。
而第三位，脸色苍白，几乎看不到一丝血色，深陷的眼窝中，一双眸子却漆黑如点墨，幽深得仿佛能吞噬光线。身形瘦高，裹在一件宽大无比的玄黑色鬼雾袍中，袍服上以银线绣着无数挣扎、哀嚎的生魂面孔。
同时他的修为最强，金丹初期圆满。
三人分别是金元宗的凌剑锋，地蛮宗的石岳，以及百鬼炼魂门的鬼尘子。
随着三人突然出现，仙宫缓缓没入空间裂缝之中。
凌剑锋眼神冰冷，率先开口：“鬼尘子，将东西交出来。”
石岳也是紧跟其后的盯着，道：“你刚刚收了三件东西，我们也不多要，一人一件。”
闻言，鬼尘子咧嘴冷笑：“呵，你们自己没拿到东西，想强逼我交出收获？”
凌剑锋上前一步，周身剑气激荡：“哼，我们三人好不容易找到传送阵，传送进入核心区域，你倒是手快，瞬间将核心区域的三件宝物收入囊中。可也是因为你这举动，导致触发仙宫的禁制，将我们三人传送出来，我们俩人可都没来得及出手。”
“那是你们废物，怎么，还得我提醒你们吗？想威逼我？也不看你们什么修为，我才是金丹初期圆满。”
鬼尘子嘲讽一笑，随即一杆漆黑旗帜出现，周围鬼影嘶吼。
石岳闻言，不怒反笑，道：“你怕是忘记了，我修炼的可是九岳镇脉诀，体魄无双。凌道友乃是剑修，修炼的可是金元宗的顶级功法：金罡剑元功。我们两人联手，战力卓绝，你才突破金丹初期圆满不久，不见得是我们的对手。”
“好大的口气，”

鬼尘子说着，突然动了。
他不想被两人缠住，尽快离去才是最好选择。
手中‘百鬼阴魂旗’迎风招展，无数怨魂在其中哀嚎，刹那百鬼夜行，成百上千的厉鬼虚影发出刺耳的尖啸，铺天盖地地涌向凌剑锋、石岳二人。
这些鬼影虽单体威力不强，却无穷无尽，更能扰乱心神，侵蚀护体灵光。
他则是趁机突围。
凌剑锋面对鬼海战术，神色不变。
他手捏剑诀，三道金色剑光凝聚，如游龙般呼啸而出。
剑光在空中交织成一张密不透风的剑网，所过之处，鬼影如冰雪消融，被凌厉的剑气绞杀成最精纯的阴气。
而石岳更是直接，他怒吼一声，全身肌肉贲张，土黄色的灵光凝聚成一副厚重的山岳战甲。
他不闪不避，如同人形凶兽般冲入鬼群，双拳挥动间撼地拳接连轰出，刚猛无俦的拳风直接将大片鬼影震成齑粉。
同时两人追击。
鬼尘子见百鬼夜行收效甚微，阴笑一声，手掐法诀。
他张口喷出一道漆黑如墨的音波，这魔音无视物理防御，直钻神魂，凌剑锋和石岳顿时感到神魂如遭针扎，一阵恍惚，剑光和拳势都为之一滞。
“是蚀魂音，封闭听觉。”
凌剑锋大喝。
但鬼尘子抓住机会，‘百鬼阴魂旗’再次摇动，此次却只飞出一道凝练如实质的鬼将虚影，手持巨斧，悄无声息地绕到侧翼，劈向身形略显迟滞的石岳。
然而，凌剑锋已经封闭听觉，反应过来了。
他并指如剑，轻喝一声“御”，一道主攻的剑光如瞬移般回撤格挡，“铛”的一声脆响，精准地架住了鬼将的巨斧。
content_en:
Xuancang East Region, Jin Yuanzong.
Jinyufang City, the most northeastern part of Jin Yuanzong, is dozens of miles away to the south.
At the end of the sky, the glazed jade tiles of a fairy palace pierce the sea of ​​clouds and cracks in space. The palace walls are flowing with pale golden glow, exuding an eternal and vast atmosphere.
Suddenly, outside the Immortal Palace, golden light flashed, and three figures appeared out of thin air.
One was wearing a golden cloud-patterned Taoist robe. He had a handsome face and looked to be in his thirties. His sword-shaped eyebrows flew into his temples, his nose was straight, and his thin lips were pursed, adding a bit of a chilling air to him.
His posture is as tall and straight as a pine tree, and when he stands still, he looks like a magic weapon in a sheath, possessing an awe-inspiring and inviolable majesty.
The other one had a rugged face, a square jaw, and was nearly nine feet tall. His muscles were as gnarled as the roots of an old tree, and he was full of explosive power. His skin had a healthy tan and was riddled with scars.
Both of them are in the early stage of Jindan cultivation.
The third person's face was pale, with almost no trace of blood visible. In the deep-set eye sockets, his eyes were as dark as ink, so deep that they seemed to be able to swallow light. The figure is tall and thin, wrapped in an extremely wide black ghost mist robe. The robe is embroidered with silver thread on the faces of countless struggling and wailing souls.
At the same time, his cultivation level is the strongest and the golden elixir is in its early stage.
The three are Ling Jianfeng from the Jin Yuan Sect, Shi Yue from the Diman Sect, and Gui Chenzi from the Hundred Ghost Soul Refining Sect.
With the sudden appearance of the three people, the Immortal Palace slowly submerged into the space crack.
Ling Jianfeng's eyes were cold and he spoke first: "Gui Chenzi, hand over the things."
Shi Yue also followed closely and stared, saying: "You just collected three things, we don't want more, just one for each person."
Hearing this, Gui Chenzi grinned and sneered: "Heh, you didn't get anything yourself, and you want to force me to hand over the harvest?"
Ling Jianfeng took a step forward, sword energy surging around his body: "Huh, the three of us finally found the teleportation array and teleported into the core area. You were quick and pocketed the three treasures in the core area in an instant. But it was also because of your actions that the ban on the Immortal Palace was triggered and the three of us were teleported out. Neither of us had time to take action."
"That's your trash. Why, do you still need me to remind you? Do you want to intimidate me? It doesn't matter what your cultivation level is. I am the perfect person in the early stage of the Golden Core."
Gui Chenzi smiled mockingly, and then a black flag appeared, with ghosts roaring around him.
Hearing this, Shi Yue smiled instead of being angry and said: "I'm afraid you have forgotten that I practice the Jiuyue Pulse Suppressing Technique, and my physical strength is unparalleled. Fellow Daoist Ling is a sword cultivator, and he practices the Jin Yuan Sect's top technique: Jin Gang Sword Yuan Gong. The two of us have joined forces and have outstanding fighting power. You have only broken through the early stages of the Golden Core, so you may not be our opponent."
"What a loud tone,"
Gui Chenzi said and suddenly moved.
He didn't want to be entangled with the two of them, so leaving as soon as possible was the best option.
The 'Hundred Ghosts and Ghosts Flag' fluttered in the wind, with countless resentful souls wailing in it. In an instant, hundreds of ghosts walked at night, and hundreds of ghost ghosts emitted ear-piercing screams, overwhelming Ling Jianfeng and Shi Yue.
Although these ghosts are not powerful individually, they are endless and can disturb the mind and corrode the protective aura.
He took the opportunity to break out.
Ling Jianfeng's expression remained unchanged when faced with the tactics of the sea of ​​ghosts.
He squeezed the sword formula with his hand, and three golden sword lights condensed and roared out like a swimming dragon.
The sword light intertwined into an airtight sword net in the air. Wherever it passed, ghost shadows melted like ice and snow, and were strangled into the purest Yin Qi by the sharp sword energy.
Shi Yue was even more direct. He roared angrily, his muscles all over his body tensed, and his khaki aura condensed into a pair of thick mountain armor.
He did not dodge or dodge, charging into the ghost crowd like a ferocious humanoid beast, swinging his fists with earth-shaking fists one after another. The fierce and unrivaled fist wind directly shook the large ghost figures into powder.
At the same time, the two men gave chase.
Seeing that hundreds of ghosts walking at night had little effect, Gui Chenzi laughed sinisterly and pinched the magic with his hands.
He opened his mouth and spurted outA sound wave as dark as ink, this demonic sound ignored the physical defense and penetrated directly into the soul. Ling Jianfeng and Shi Yue suddenly felt as if their souls were being pricked by needles. They were in a daze, and the sword light and fist movements were stagnated.
"It's a soul-eating sound that blocks hearing."
Ling Jianfeng shouted.
But Gui Chenzi seized the opportunity and waved the 'Hundred Ghost Ghost Flag' again. This time, only a condensed and substantial shadow of the ghost general flew out. Holding a giant ax, he silently circled to the flank and struck at Shi Yue, who was slightly sluggish.
However, Ling Jianfeng had already blocked his hearing and reacted.
He pointed like a sword and shouted "Yu" softly, and the sword light of the main attack retreated to block like a teleportation. With a crisp "ding" sound, he accurately held the ghost general's giant axe.
